import sys

MOD = 998244353
INV2 = 499122177

def pow_mod(base, exp):
    if exp <= 0:
        return 1 % MOD
    half = pow_mod(base, exp // 2)
    half = (half * half) % MOD
    if exp & 1:
        half = (half * (base % MOD)) % MOD
    return half

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    l = int(data[2])
    r = int(data[3])

    d = r - l + 1
    a = d // 2
    b = d - a
    nm = n * m
    diff = abs(a - b)

    ans = (pow_mod(d, nm) + pow_mod(diff, nm)) % MOD
    ans = (ans * INV2) % MOD
    if nm % 2 == 1:
        ans = pow_mod(d, nm)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
